1600.name: The Path of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Gate Of Fameland.

1600.description:
The Path of Heroes begins at a broad arch of weathered stone, its
flagstones worn into shallow troughs by the feet of ages. The way south
leads back through the white pillars of the gate of Fameland. A cold
wind carries a faint hum from somewhere deep in the ruin. The path runs
on north between rows of toppled columns, each one carved with a faded
laurel.

1601.name: The Path of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Heroes.

1601.description:
Broken columns line both sides of the path here, their fluting chipped
and their bases sunk in drifted dust. A cracked basin of black stone
stands by the verge, long dry and ringed with old green stain. Grey
light falls aslant from a sky the colour of pewter. The path continues
north and south through the ruin.

1602.name: The Path of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Heroes.

1602.description:
A great statue of a robed hero stands on a plinth beside the path, its
face worn smooth by wind and one stone hand held out with the palm open.
Lichen has crept across the carved cloak in orange patches. Faint
scratches mark the flagstones where pilgrims once knelt. The path runs
north deeper into the ruin and south back the way you came.

extra_descs.statue hero plinth:
The statue shows a hero in a long robe, one hand open as if to welcome
the traveller. The name on the plinth has been chiselled away.

1603.name: The Path of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Path of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Heroes.

1603.description:
Here the flagstones are cracked and heaved by the roots of thorn bushes
that have taken hold in the gaps. Fallen blocks of grey marble lie in
heaps beside the path, some still bearing a fragment of carved
inscription. A low hum rises and falls, as if the ground itself were
breathing. The path goes on north and south.

1604.name: The Path of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies The Junction of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Heroes.

1604.description:
The path widens into a paved court that narrows again toward the
crossing ahead. Rows of stone plinths stand empty on either side, their
statues long since stolen or shattered. Pale pebbles crunch underfoot,
and the hum of the rift is plainer here. The Junction of Ancients lies
just north, where several ways meet, and the path runs back south.

1605.name: The Junction of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

east.description: To the east lies The Walkway of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies The Path of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Heroes.

1605.description:
Four ways meet at a great round plaza paved in black and white stone,
its centre marked by a cracked ring of bronze set flush with the ground.
The Way of Ancients leaves north between tall columns, while the Walkway
of Bones runs east, pale and strange in the gloom. West the Way of
Heroes passes under a line of lofty statues, and the path you came by
runs south. The air is heavy with age and the hum of the rift.

1606.name: The Way of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies The Junction of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Heroes.

1606.description:
The Way of Heroes ends in a broad approach paved with mosaic, tiny tiles
laid in the shape of a wreath and half lost to weather. A tall column
with a cracked capital marks the edge, and beyond it the Junction of
Ancients waits to the east. The road runs west along the avenue of
heroes. Thin grass pushes through the mosaic.

1607.name: The Walkway of Bones

east.description: To the east lies The Walkway of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies The Junction of Ancients.

1607.description:
The walkway begins here as a raised causeway of pale stone, its surface
inlaid with row upon row of ancient bones set into the paving in strange
patterns. Leg-bones and ribs form spirals, and skulls are set into the
low walls like cobbles. The air is dry and sharp with the scent of old
dust. The causeway runs east into the gloom and west to the plaza.

extra_descs.bones skulls patterns:
The bones are set with strange care into spirals and rings. Whoever laid
them meant the pattern to be walked.

1608.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Junction of Ancients.

1608.description:
The Way of Ancients is a broad avenue of dark paving, flanked by tall
pillars carved with the names of long-dead champions, most of them worn
past reading. Wind sighs through gaps in the colonnade. A thin drift of
dead leaves has gathered against the plinths. The avenue runs north into
the ruin and south back to the plaza of the junction.

1609.name: The Way of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies A Room of Slaying.

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies A Room of Slaying.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Heroes.

1609.description:
This wide crossroads on the Way of Heroes holds a great circle of pale
flags laid out like a shield. Doors to the north and south open into two
more rooms of Slaying, their lintels graven with spears. The avenue goes
on east toward the junction and west along the line of columns. Wind
whirls dust and dried leaves around the shield-circle.

1610.name: The Way of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies A Room of Slaying.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Heroes.

1610.description:
Slender pillars flank the avenue, each topped with a stone eagle with a
broken beak. A doorway to the south leads into a Room of Slaying. Loose
gravel and shards of pottery crunch underfoot. The avenue runs east and
west along its line of columns.

1611.name: A Room of Slaying

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Heroes.

1611.description:
A cold small chamber of dark stone, its walls scored with rows of
notches, each a tally of battles won. A stone table stands in the
centre, stained and chipped. The air is stale and heavy. The only way
out is the doorway south, which returns to the Way of Heroes.

1612.name: A Room of Slaying

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Heroes.

1612.description:
A narrow chamber where a long stone bench runs beneath a row of iron
hooks, each hook once holding a trophy of some great kill. A thin shaft
of light falls through a crack in the vault. The floor is gritty with
ash. The only way out is the arch north, back to the Way of Heroes.

1613.name: The Way of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies A Room of Slaying.

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Heroes.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Heroes.

1613.description:
Four stone braziers stand at the corners of a small crossing, each
blackened inside by fires lit for forgotten feasts. A low doorway to the
north opens into a Room of Slaying, its lintel carved with a ring of
broken spears. The avenue runs on east and west, its paving scattered
with rusted nails and splinters of old shafts.

1614.name: A Room of Slaying

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Heroes.

1614.description:
Rough pillars stand in the corners of this small chamber of slaying,
each wrapped in rusty chain. Pale scorch marks climb the walls in
tongues. A heavy stone block, hollowed like a trough, stands in the
middle, its rim chipped deeply. A doorway north returns to the Way of
Heroes.

1615.name: A Room of Slaying

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Heroes.

1615.description:
This low square chamber is a dead end, its walls hung with ancient
trophy-racks that hold only splinters and rust. Great stains darken the
floor in a ring. Carved beasts, all pierced by spears, run around the
frieze. The only way out is the doorway south, back to the Way of
Heroes.

1616.name: The Way of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Room of Might.

1616.description:
The Way of Heroes starts here as a wide avenue paved in blue-grey slabs,
lined by statues of warriors in crested helms. A fountain basin, dry and
cracked, stands against a ruined wall. Low arches at the south end of
the street lead into the Room of Might. The avenue runs east into the
ruin beneath a hard grey sky.

1617.name: The Room of Might

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Heroes.

down.description: To the down lies The Room of Perseverance.

1617.description:
Great stone weights, anvils and iron-bound bars lie scattered across the
floor of this high chamber, tests of strength left by champions long
gone. The walls are thick with scratches counting lifts and throws. A
wide arch to the north opens on the Way of Heroes, and a stair leads
down to the Room of Perseverance. The air smells of cold iron.

1618.name: The Walkway of Bones

south.description: To the south lies The Walkway of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies The Walkway of Bones.

1618.description:
The causeway turns here from the west toward the south, and the bones in
the paving gather into the wide curve of a giant ribcage. Whitened tusks
and horns are set upright along the wall like the teeth of some vast
beast. A cold hum shivers through the stones. The walkway goes on south,
and west runs back toward the plaza.

1619.name: The Walkway of Bones

north.description: To the north lies The Walkway of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies A Junction in The Walkway of Bones.

1619.description:
The walkway runs straight between two walls built entirely of stacked
skulls, row on row, grinning in the dim. Their hollows are stuffed with
the pale dust of ages. The hum of the rift grows louder, almost a low
chant. The causeway leads north toward the bend and south to a junction.

1620.name: A Junction in The Walkway of Bones

north.description: To the north lies The Walkway of Bones.

east.description: To the east lies The Room of Elders.

south.description: To the south lies The Room of Bravery.

west.description: To the west lies The Room of Courage.

1620.description:
Three doorways open from a small court where the walkway meets, each
beneath a lintel of carved bone. They lead east to the Room of Elders,
south to the Room of Bravery and west to the Room of Courage, while the
walkway runs back north. A circle of old bronze is set into the ground,
graven with a pattern of crossed swords. A hush hangs here, thick as
felt.

1621.name: The Room of Bravery

north.description: To the north lies A Junction in The Walkway of Bones.

1621.description:
A dim round chamber whose floor is laid with a mosaic of a lone figure
facing a great dark mass, much of it lost under dust. Torch sconces hang
empty. The ceiling is low and domed, black with the soot of vanished
fires. The only way out is the doorway north, to the junction of the
walkway.

1622.name: The Room of Courage

east.description: To the east lies A Junction in The Walkway of Bones.

1622.description:
A bare, narrow chamber lit by a single slit that casts a blade of light
across the floor. Along the walls are carved the names of those who
faced death here, and some of the letters are still sharp. A cracked
stone shield hangs on the far wall. The doorway east opens on the
walkway junction.

extra_descs.names carved letters:
The names are cut in a dozen different hands. Beneath the last is a
blank space, as if the wall were waiting.

1623.name: The Room of Elders

east.description: To the east lies The Room of Perseverance.

west.description: To the west lies A Junction in The Walkway of Bones.

1623.description:
A long hall of cold stone, its walls lined with niches in which stone
figures of bearded elders sit, hands folded on their knees. A single
oil-black lamp hangs from the vaulted ceiling by a chain. Dust lies
thick on the floor except along a line of footprints worn into the
flags. A doorway east leads deeper, and the arch west returns to the
walkway.

1624.name: The Room of Perseverance

west.description: To the west lies The Room of Elders.

up.description: To the up lies The Room of Might.

1624.description:
This is a round chamber where a spiral stair of worn steps climbs the
wall to an opening in the ceiling. Every step is hollowed in the middle
by centuries of patient feet. Carved on the walls in ring after ring are
tallies of trials endured, each stroke scratched by a different hand.
Torch brackets stand empty. The only other way out is the arch to the
west, and the stair leads up to the Room of Might.

1625.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

1625.description:
Great urns of weathered bronze stand along the avenue, green with
verdigris and dented by some ancient violence. Between them the paving
is scored with long gouges, as though something heavy was dragged across
it. Pale moss grows in the cracks. The way continues north and south.

1626.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies A Junction in The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

1626.description:
The avenue runs between two rows of columns here, and the roofless sky
above is streaked with slow cloud. A broken arch spans the road, one
half still standing, the other lying in tumbled blocks. Dust hangs in
the slanting light. The Way of Ancients goes on north to a junction and
south the way you came.

1627.name: A Junction in The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1627.description:
At this junction the avenue splits, one arm running east and the other
west, while the road you followed ends at a squat stone pedestal. The
pedestal is bare, though a ring of chiselled laurel still circles its
edge. Cold air slides along the paving from both ways. Dust and fallen
pebbles dance in small whirls on the stones, and the way back lies
south.

extra_descs.pedestal laurel:
The pedestal once held a statue, for four bronze bolts still stand in
its top. Around its rim runs a laurel wreath, cut with great care.

1628.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies A Junction in The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1628.description:
Flat paving stones, worn into a gentle dip, mark the line of the avenue
between two broken walls. Scrubby grass grows in thin tufts along the
margins, and a wind-twisted sapling clings to a crack. Scraps of blue
glass glint in the dust where some window once stood. The junction lies
a few paces east, and the road runs on west.

1629.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

1629.description:
A shallow channel runs along the middle of the road, once a watercourse
for some forgotten rite and now filled with black mud and reeds. Stone
lions crouch at intervals along the verge, though weather has taken
their manes and mouths. The air is damp, and the hum of the rift is only
a murmur here. East the road meets a junction; west it bends.

1630.name: A Bend in The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

1630.description:
Here the avenue turns, swinging from the north toward the east beneath a
vast broken arch whose keystone hangs by a thread. Fragments of carved
garlands litter the paving. A strong draught moves through the arch with
a low moan. The road runs east along its length, and the way back lies
north.

1631.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

1631.description:
The road is bordered on one side by a low parapet of white stone, beyond
which a sheer drop falls into mist, the edge of some older terrace of
the city. Cold fog beads on the stone. Cracks run through the paving
like frozen lightning. The avenue goes north and south from here.

1632.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

1632.description:
Long shadows lie across the road, cast by a row of leaning obelisks
inscribed with columns of tiny script. A few have fallen and split. The
stone underfoot is cold and slick with dew, and a sour smell of wet
earth rises from the gaps. The way goes north to a bend and south along
the avenue.

1633.name: A Bend in The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

1633.description:
The avenue swings from the east toward the south here, curving around a
low mound of rubble that was once a tower. Blocks the size of oxen lie
half buried in thistles. A line of faint carved stars is still visible
on the nearest wall. East lies the straight road toward the temple, and
the way south runs on along the avenue.

1634.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

1634.description:
Tall thin pillars stand in pairs along the road, each pair once holding
a banner now rotted to nothing but rings of corroded iron. Nests of dry
twigs crowd the capitals. The paving is pitted by centuries of rain, and
puddles shine in the hollows. The road runs east toward the temple vault
and west to a bend.

1635.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Road to The Temple.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1635.description:
The avenue runs on beside a long wall hung with the rust-brown remains
of iron shields, their devices eaten away. Underfoot, the paving is
cracked and strewn with pale gravel that crunches loudly. A cold draught
breathes from the vaulted road to the east. West, the way stretches
toward a bend.

1636.name: The Road to The Temple

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Rift.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1636.description:
This is a vaulted hall of grey stone, a long echoing passage where the
Way of Ancients runs under a roof. Thick pillars march along both walls,
and iron braziers stand cold in the corners. The hum of the rift is
strongest here, shivering through the floor. Ways lead east toward the
gateposts and west along the avenue, while a broad opening in the south
wall leads to the Rift.

1637.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Road to The Temple.

1637.description:
A pair of massive gateposts stands at the road's end, carved with
spiralling runes and linked by a lintel cracked clean through. Beyond
them lies the dim, shadowed mouth of the Road to the Temple. The air is
cooler and smells of stone and distant storms. The avenue returns the
way you came, toward the east.

1638.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies Another Bend in The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1638.description:
The avenue runs between rows of cracked statues, some headless, some
armless, all grey with the soot of old fires. A shallow gutter crosses
the road, choked with fine silt and the brittle bones of small beasts.
The hum of the rift is loud now, a deep and steady note felt in the
chest. East the road bends; west it runs toward a gloomy gateway.

1639.name: Another Bend in The Way of Ancients

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1639.description:
The road bends here around a huge fallen head of weathered stone, a
heroic face half sunk in the paving. Its blank eyes stare at the sky,
and ivy trails across its brow like a wreath of green. The hum of the
rift is felt in the soles of your feet. The way leads south along the
avenue and west along a straighter stretch.

extra_descs.head face fallen:
The stone head is taller than a man, with a strong jaw and a worn crown.
It seems to have fallen from some great statue long ago.

1640.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies Another Bend in The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies The Way of Ancients.

1640.description:
A line of stone benches borders the avenue, polished smooth by those who
once rested here to watch processions pass. Most are cracked, and one
has fallen into two halves with a rusted iron spike between them. The
wind carries the dry smell of old dust and ash. The road bends ahead to
the north and runs south toward the earlier bend.

1641.name: The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

1641.description:
Narrow and cold, the avenue here runs between two high walls of fitted
blocks, so that only a strip of sky shows overhead. Faded paint clings
to the stonework in flecks of red and ochre, the last trace of a victory
frieze. Water drips somewhere unseen. The road runs on north and south.

1642.name: A Bend in The Way of Ancients

north.description: To the north lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1642.description:
The avenue turns sharply here, curving from the west toward the north
around a round platform of cracked tiles. At its centre a stone basin
holds a skin of dark rainwater. Carved reliefs of marching warriors run
along the low wall, their faces scoured by weather. The way continues
north, and west lies the long straight road you walked.

1643.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies A Bend in The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies The Way of Ancients.

1643.description:
Tall grass and thistles grow thick in the cracks of the paving, bending
in the wind that moves along the avenue. A toppled column lies across
half the road, its drums rolled apart like coins. The stone beneath is
scorched in a long dark stripe. The avenue bends ahead to the east and
runs back west toward the junction.

1644.name: The Way of Ancients

east.description: To the east lies The Way of Ancients.

west.description: To the west lies A Junction in The Way of Ancients.

1644.description:
The avenue runs straight and level between low walls of dark stone half
buried in creeping ivy. The paving here is unusually smooth, polished by
countless processions. A line of cracked bronze lamps hangs from iron
arms, empty of oil for centuries. The junction lies west, and the road
goes on east.

1645.name: The Rift

north.description: To the north lies The Road to The Temple.

south.description: To the south lies The Temple Of Garathorm.

1645.description:
The ground ends in a vast ragged chasm that splits the city, its far lip
lost in shadow and a pale light pulsing in its depths. A narrow bridge
of fitted stone crosses it to the broad marble stair of the Temple of
Garathorm, which rises to the south. The air shakes with the great hum,
and a cold wind tugs at your clothes. To the north is the vaulted Road
to the Temple.

642900.name: skeleton bone sentry
642900.long_desc: A bone sentry in rusted mail stands rigid on the paving, a notched spear in its hands.
642900.description:
A skeleton still bound in the corroded mail of some old guard. Pale fire
gutters in its empty sockets as it turns to follow you.

642901.name: ghost shade hero
642901.long_desc: A hero's shade drifts above the stones, its pale hand tightening on a sword that is not there.
642901.description:
The faint outline of a warrior in an antique crested helm, thin as mist.
It keeps the old trials and does not suffer the living to pass them
unchallenged.

642902.name: raven crow black
642902.long_desc: A black raven perches on a broken column, watching you with a bright unblinking eye.
642902.description:
A big raven with feathers dusted white by the ruin. It pecks at the old
bones in the paving and croaks at anything that comes near.

642903.name: guardian statue granite golem
642903.long_desc: A granite guardian stands in the doorway, its stone sword resting across its chest.
642903.description:
A statue of a heavy-browed warrior given terrible life by the rift. Dust
trickles from its joints with every slow step.

642904.name: wraith slayer spectre
642904.long_desc: A slayer wraith circles the chamber, a spear of grey light in its fist.
642904.description:
The ghost of a hunter bound to the Rooms of Slaying, its body ragged
smoke and its eyes hard as flint. It forever repeats the throw that
killed it.

642905.name: elder verun keeper trials ghost
642905.long_desc: Elder Verun, Keeper of Trials, stands beside the worn stair with a staff of pale bone.
642905.description:
The ghost of the eldest of the first heroes, bent and bearded, with eyes
like cold lamps. He judges every traveller who comes to the stair, and
finds most wanting.

642906.name: ancient champion warrior spirit
642906.long_desc: The Ancient Champion stands at the lip of the Rift, a vast blade of grey light held low at his side.
642906.description:
The greatest of the first heroes, a towering figure in antique plate,
still keeping watch over the chasm. His voice is the hum of the rift
itself, and his sword has not been lowered in a thousand years.

742900.name: spear notched sentry
742900.room_desc: A notched sentry spear lies here.
742900.description: A long spear with a pitted iron head and a shaft gone dark with age. It is still well balanced.

742901.name: circlet laurel bronze
742901.room_desc: A bronze laurel circlet lies here.
742901.description: A circlet of cast bronze leaves, green at the edges. It is cold even in the hand.

742902.name: shard granite carved
742902.room_desc: A carved granite shard lies here.
742902.description: A palm-sized piece of old statuary, with part of a stern stone face still cut into it. Collectors pay well for such relics.

742903.name: signet ring elder silver
742903.room_desc: A worn silver signet ring lies here.
742903.description: A heavy silver ring stamped with the seal of the first elders. It hums faintly with the rift.

742904.name: blade champion greatsword grey
742904.room_desc: The Champion's grey greatsword lies here, humming softly.
742904.description: A great blade of dull grey steel, etched with the names of the first heroes. It hums with the rift whenever it is drawn.
